name: qdrant_list_collections
description: List all vector collections in the Qdrant database

name: qdrant_get_collection
description: Get info about a specific Qdrant vector collection including vector count and config

name: qdrant_create_collection
description: Create a new Qdrant vector collection. Specify vector_size (e.g. 1536 for OpenAI embeddings) and distance metric.

name: qdrant_delete_collection
description: Delete a Qdrant vector collection and all its data

name: qdrant_get_collection_info
description: Get detailed info about a Qdrant collection including status, vector count, and disk usage

name: qdrant_update_collection
description: Update optimizer and HNSW config for a Qdrant collection

name: qdrant_upsert_points
description: Insert or update vectors in a Qdrant collection. Each point needs id, vector (embedding array), and optional payload.

name: qdrant_get_point
description: Get a specific vector point from Qdrant by its ID

name: qdrant_get_points
description: Get multiple vector points from Qdrant by their IDs

name: qdrant_delete_points
description: Delete specific vector points from a Qdrant collection by their IDs

name: qdrant_count_points
description: Count the number of vectors in a Qdrant collection, optionally filtered

name: qdrant_scroll_points
description: Iterate through all points in a Qdrant collection with pagination

name: qdrant_update_payload
description: Update the payload (metadata) of existing Qdrant points without changing the vectors

name: qdrant_delete_payload
description: Delete specific payload keys from Qdrant points

name: qdrant_search
description: Search for similar vectors in Qdrant using a query vector (embedding). Returns top-k most similar results.

vector.description: Embedding array from OpenAI or similar

name: qdrant_search_batch
description: Run multiple vector similarity searches at once in Qdrant

name: qdrant_recommend
description: Find Qdrant vectors similar to positive examples and dissimilar to negative examples
